description: An aftermarket three-way catalytic converter (Series 92100, round type) approved for non-OBD-II equipped vehicles up to 5.9L (360 CID) engine size and 6,000 lbs test weight.

fitment.trim_note: Applies to non-OBD-II equipped vehicles with engine size up to 5.9L (360 CID) and vehicle test weight up to 6,000 lbs (not for OBD-II equipped vehicles). Emissions tested on a 1994 5.9L Dodge Pickup 2500.

notes: This EO defines applicability by engine size/vehicle weight class and OBD status rather than by specific make/model/year, so make, model, and year fields are null; the 1994 Dodge Pickup 2500 is only the emissions test vehicle used to validate performance, not a fitment list. An internal 'Aftermarket Parts Section' checklist page (included in the PDF, for internal ARB use only) refers to the device as 'Series 92000 non-OBD II TWC', while the operative Executive Order text and table both say 'Series 92100' (Round). This discrepancy is transcribed as-is; '92000' was not added to part_numbers since the operative order and table consistently use 92100. Executive Order D-562-5 (dated October 30, 2006) is explicitly superseded per the order text.
